# WMC Portfolio API

> REST API (FastAPI) behind the Next.js BFF. Portfolio ledger, analytics, optimization,
> risk, forecasting and Stripe billing. JSON in, JSON out. Generated from the route
> declarations by `scripts/gen_llms_txt.py`; `tests/unit/test_llms_txt.py` fails if it
> drifts from the live routes.

## Conventions

- Auth: `Authorization: Bearer <JWT>` from `POST /auth/login`. Auth column: `public`
  (no token), `user` (valid token), `pro` (valid token and an active Pro subscription).
- Every portfolio route is scoped to the token's user; a foreign or unknown
  `portfolio_id` returns 404, never 403.
- Errors: `{"detail": "<message>"}` with 400/401/402/403/404/409/422/429/502/503.
  429 carries `Retry-After`. 422 is request validation.
- Rate limits are per client IP (some per user); the limit shown is the route-level one.
- Interactive OpenAPI docs are disabled when `ENVIRONMENT=production`; this file is the
  reference there.
- Plans and prices live in `services/billing/plans.py`; the owner guide is
  `docs/OWNER_GUIDE.md`.

## Endpoints

### POST /analytics/assets

Compute per-asset data: correlations, metrics, returns, impact analysis. Auth: user.

- body `AssetsAnalyticsRequest` { portfolio_id: str, start_date: date, end_date: date, benchmark_ticker: str | None }

### POST /analytics/calculate

Portfolio performance and risk metrics for a date range, optionally against a benchmark or comparison. Auth: user.

- body `AnalyticsRequest` { portfolio_id: str, start_date: date, end_date: date, benchmark_ticker: str | None, comparison_type: str | None, comparison_value: str | None }

### POST /auth/login

Login with OAuth2 password form (username field = email). Auth: public. Rate limit: 20/minute.

- body form-urlencoded `username` (email), `password`

### POST /auth/login/json

Login with JSON body (convenient for frontend). Auth: public. Rate limit: 20/minute.

- body `LoginRequest` { email: EmailStr, password: str }

### GET /auth/me

Return the authenticated user profile. Auth: user.


### POST /auth/register

Register a new user account. Auth: public. Rate limit: 10/minute.

- body `RegisterRequest` { email: EmailStr, password: str }

### POST /billing/checkout

Create a Stripe Checkout session for the Pro plan; returns {url}. 503 if billing is not configured. Auth: user.


### POST /billing/portal

Create a Stripe customer-portal session; returns {url}. 503 if billing is not configured. Auth: user.


### GET /billing/status

Current user's plan, subscription status and period end. Auth: user.


### GET /dashboard/indices

Market index quotes for the dashboard strip. Auth: public.


### POST /forecasting/asset

Forecast one asset's price path. Auth: pro.

- body `ForecastAssetRequest` { ticker: str, start_date: date, end_date: date, horizon: int, method: str, method_params: dict[str, Any] | None, out_of_sample: bool, training_ratio: float }

### POST /forecasting/batch

Forecast several assets in one call. Auth: pro.

- body `ForecastBatchRequest` { scope: str, ticker: str | None, portfolio_id: str | None, start_date: date, end_date: date, horizon: int, methods: list[str], method_params: dict[str, dict[str, Any]], out_of_sample: bool, training_ratio: float, create_ensemble: bool }

### POST /forecasting/portfolio

Forecast a whole portfolio's value. Auth: pro.

- body `ForecastPortfolioRequest` { portfolio_id: str, start_date: date, end_date: date, horizon: int, method: str, method_params: dict[str, Any] | None, out_of_sample: bool, training_ratio: float }

### GET /health

Liveness probe; returns {status: ok}. Auth: public.


### POST /optimization/full

Run an optimization method and return weights, frontier and metrics for a saved portfolio. Auth: pro.

- body `OptimizationFullRequest` { benchmark_for_charts: str | None, include_efficient_frontier: bool, frontier_n_points: int, include_sensitivity: bool, sensitivity_analysis_type: str, notebook_split: bool, notebook_train_fraction: float }

### POST /optimization/run

Run one optimization method on a list of tickers. Auth: pro.

- body `OptimizationRequest` { portfolio_id: str, method: str, start_date: date, end_date: date, constraints: dict[str, Any] | None, benchmark_ticker: str | None, method_params: dict[str, Any] | None, out_of_sample: bool, training_ratio: float }

### GET /portfolios

List the user's portfolios. Auth: user.


### POST /portfolios

Create a portfolio. Auth: user.

- body `CreatePortfolioRequest` (JSON body)

### DELETE /portfolios/{portfolio_id}

Delete a portfolio and its ledger. Auth: user.

- path `portfolio_id`: str

### GET /portfolios/{portfolio_id}

Get one portfolio. Auth: user.

- path `portfolio_id`: str

### PATCH /portfolios/{portfolio_id}

Update portfolio fields. Auth: user.

- path `portfolio_id`: str
- body `UpdatePortfolioRequest` (JSON body)

### GET /portfolios/{portfolio_id}/dividends

List dividends received by the portfolio. Auth: user.

- path `portfolio_id`: str
- body `date | None` (JSON body)
- body `date | None` (JSON body)

### POST /portfolios/{portfolio_id}/dividends/sync

Fetch and record missing dividends from the market data provider. Auth: user.

- path `portfolio_id`: str
- body `DividendSyncRequest` { tickers: TickerList, start_date: date, end_date: date, reinvest: bool }

### GET /portfolios/{portfolio_id}/holdings

Current holdings with quantities and values. Auth: user.

- path `portfolio_id`: str

### POST /portfolios/{portfolio_id}/ledger/maintain

Sync splits, dividends and scheduled rebalances; partial failures are reported in maintain_error. Auth: user.

- path `portfolio_id`: str

### GET /portfolios/{portfolio_id}/optimization-snapshot

Current holdings with live prices (Streamlit expander). Auth: user.

- path `portfolio_id`: str

### GET /portfolios/{portfolio_id}/pnl

Realized and unrealized profit and loss. Auth: user.

- path `portfolio_id`: str

### POST /portfolios/{portfolio_id}/positions

Add a position to the portfolio. Auth: user.

- path `portfolio_id`: str
- body `AddPositionRequest` (JSON body)

### DELETE /portfolios/{portfolio_id}/positions/{ticker}

Remove a position. Auth: user.

- path `portfolio_id`: str
- path `ticker`: str

### PATCH /portfolios/{portfolio_id}/positions/{ticker}

Update a position. Auth: user.

- path `portfolio_id`: str
- path `ticker`: str
- body `UpdatePositionRequest` (JSON body)

### POST /portfolios/{portfolio_id}/rebalance/execute

Apply a rebalance and record its transactions. Auth: user.

- path `portfolio_id`: str
- body `RebalanceRequest` { as_of_date: date | None, run_scheduled: bool, through_date: date | None }

### POST /portfolios/{portfolio_id}/rebalance/preview

Show the trades a rebalance would make without saving. Auth: user.

- path `portfolio_id`: str
- body `RebalanceRequest` { as_of_date: date | None, run_scheduled: bool, through_date: date | None }

### POST /portfolios/{portfolio_id}/splits/sync

Fetch and apply missing stock splits. Auth: user.

- path `portfolio_id`: str
- body `SplitSyncRequest` { tickers: TickerList, start_date: date, end_date: date }

### GET /portfolios/{portfolio_id}/strategy

Get the portfolio's target-weight strategy. Auth: user.

- path `portfolio_id`: str

### PUT /portfolios/{portfolio_id}/strategy

Save the portfolio's strategy and rebalance schedule. Auth: user.

- path `portfolio_id`: str
- body `UpdateStrategyRequest` (JSON body)

### POST /portfolios/{portfolio_id}/strategy/preview

Preview a strategy against current holdings without saving. Auth: user.

- path `portfolio_id`: str
- body `StrategyPreviewRequest` { as_of_date: date | None }

### GET /portfolios/{portfolio_id}/transactions

List the portfolio's transactions. Auth: user.

- path `portfolio_id`: str
- query `transaction_type`: str | None
- query `ticker`: str | None
- query `sync_ledger`: bool
- body `date | None` (JSON body)
- body `date | None` (JSON body)

### POST /portfolios/{portfolio_id}/transactions

Record a transaction in the portfolio ledger. Auth: user.

- path `portfolio_id`: str
- body `AddTransactionRequest` { transaction_date: date, transaction_type: str, ticker: str, shares: float, price: float, fees: float, notes: str | None, reinvest: bool | None, split_ratio: float | None, currency: str }

### DELETE /portfolios/{portfolio_id}/transactions/{transaction_id}

Delete a transaction of this portfolio. Auth: user.

- path `portfolio_id`: str
- path `transaction_id`: str

### POST /risk/custom-scenario

Apply user-defined shocks to a portfolio. Auth: user.

- body `CustomScenarioApiRequest` { portfolio_id: str, name: str, description: str, market_impact_pct: float, asset_impacts: dict[str, float] }

### POST /risk/monte-carlo

Monte Carlo simulation on a ticker list.. One concurrent run per user. Auth: user. Rate limit: 1 concurrent run per user.

- body `RiskMonteCarloRequest` { portfolio_id: str, start_date: date, end_date: date, time_horizon: int, num_simulations: int, initial_value: float, model: str }

### POST /risk/monte-carlo/full

Monte Carlo simulation for a saved portfolio. Auth: user. Rate limit: 1 concurrent run per user.

- body `RiskMonteCarloFullRequest` { include_sample_paths: bool }

### POST /risk/scenario-chain

Apply a chain of scenarios in sequence. Auth: user.

- body `ScenarioChainApiRequest` { portfolio_id: str, name: str, description: str, scenario_keys: list[str] }

### GET /risk/scenarios

Catalog of built-in stress scenarios. Auth: public.


### POST /risk/stress-tests

Stress-test a ticker list against scenarios. Auth: user.

- body `StressTestRequest` { portfolio_id: str, scenario_names: list[str] }

### POST /risk/stress-tests/full

Historical scenarios bundle: recovery paths, breakdowns, timelines (Streamlit parity). Auth: user.

- body `StressTestRequest` { portfolio_id: str, scenario_names: list[str] }

### POST /risk/var

Value at Risk and CVaR for a ticker list. Auth: user.

- body `RiskVarRequest` { portfolio_id: str, start_date: date, end_date: date, confidence_level: float, include_monte_carlo: bool, num_simulations: int, time_horizon: int }

### POST /risk/var/full

Value at Risk and CVaR for a saved portfolio. Auth: user.

- body `RiskVarFullRequest` { rolling_window: int }

### POST /stripe/webhook

Stripe webhook. Verifies the signature, dedups by event id, re-fetches the subscription and updates plan state. Auth: public.

- raw body + `Stripe-Signature` header; called by Stripe only

### GET /ticker-price/{ticker}

Latest price for one ticker. Auth: public. Rate limit: 60/minute.

- path `ticker`: str
- query `on_date`: date | None

### DELETE /transactions/{transaction_id}

Deprecated: prefer DELETE /portfolios/{id}/transactions/{tx_id}. Auth: user.

- path `transaction_id`: str

### POST /validate-tickers

Check which tickers exist and return their latest price. Auth: public. Rate limit: 30/minute.

- body `Annotated[TickerList, Body()]` (JSON body)
